facebook.content: Marriage isn’t a contract; it’s a covenant throne room. When we see “husband and wife become one flesh” (Genesis 2:24) as a royal decree, we understand the marriage bed is a sacred altar where God’s authority is exercised. Your unity becomes a platform for His kingdom, not a compromise of it. What kingdom‑advancing purpose are you neglecting by treating marriage as merely a partnership? Share the shift you feel.
